purpose: Current-table and retained-tree tactical source mapping for all Raid Lab selector entries, not a scripted schedule or all-boss native validation.
qualification: Current Monster/Skill/Parts/QTE rows are decoded from the installed-client-bound table archive. Retained local BT keys match current MonsterTable SpotAi, but retained BT bytes have no current installed-asset hash parity; BT node IDs are source locators pending verification.

QuickTimeEventTable MonsterId linkage may cover several encounter variants. A QTE row is included as a mode tactic only if its ID appears in the retained mode-specific BT QuickTimeEvent node; unreferenced linked row IDs remain explicitly listed and cannot authorize action.
MonsterTable SkillData SkillId 0 is an empty slot sentinel; it is counted separately, never treated as a missing skill row.
Raw table cast/QTE time values are not assumed seconds. All action triggers require live original events/state.
A MonsterSkill target-cover ratio is a targeting weight, not cover protection; penetration is a hazard signal, not proof that cover fails.
Static QTE circle rows do not establish activation timing or camera hit position. Original live collider enabled/order/HP/time/position and shot result govern targeting.
Only Kraken diagnostic node 230 and QTE group 212 were tactically native validated in trials 120/121; no other boss has native tactical validation.
